fusions.name: Noticed Flaw
fusions.desc: Fires a spicule into the flaw you noticed: it deals 15 damage to the first enemy it meets, uses up every affliction you have on it and deals 60% more damage for each one, and leaves it [Marked] for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Lidless Thousand
fusions.desc: Stings everything in a cone 4 tiles long for 4 damage. Its damage rises 8% for each affliction already on the target, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Gorgon's Regard
fusions.desc: Your stare stiffens flesh into coral, holding every creature within 4 tiles in place for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Watched Wounds
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on that enemy, up to 10. Your next critical hit on it spends them all: a blow strikes it for 20% of your weapon damage per stack (204% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
